caption: Santa Maria Maggiore, Rome
composition: Baroque loggia facade with single Romanesque brick campanile on Piazza di Santa Maria Maggiore · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist faces Santa Maria Maggiore's Baroque loggia across the piazza, its two tiers of arches filling the center with statues crowning the balustrade above. The tall brick Romanesque campanile rises at the right edge beside the basilica's flank, and the wide steps descend to the cobbled square. The 11:45 sun is bright under a clear blue sky, washing the travertine front in warm light.
